question: What is the percentage of cards whose language is French among the Story Spotlight cards?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1

turns.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE 
    c.isStorySpotlight = 1

question: Among the sets of cards that have an Italian translation, how many of them have a base set number of under 100?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T2.translation IS NOT NULL AND T1.baseSetSize < 100 AND T2.language = 'Italian'

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) 
FROM sets s 
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode 
WHERE st.language = 'Italian' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL AND s.baseSetSize < 100

question: What is the foreign name of the card in French of type Creature, normal layout and black border color, by artist Matthew D. Wilson?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM foreign_data WHERE uuid IN ( SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE types = 'Creature' AND layout = 'normal' AND borderColor = 'black' AND artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson' ) AND language = 'French'

turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fd.name 
FROM foreign_data fd 
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid 
WHERE fd.language = 'French' 
  AND c.type = 'Creature' 
  AND c.layout = 'normal' 
  AND c.borderColor = 'black' 
  AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson'

turns.hint: 컬럼명이 type이 아니라 types(복수형)야. DISTINCT는 빼야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT fd.name 
FROM foreign_data fd 
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid 
WHERE fd.language = 'French' 
  AND c.types = 'Creature' 
  AND c.layout = 'normal' 
  AND c.borderColor = 'black' 
  AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson'

question: How many of the banned cards are white border?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.borderColor = 'white'

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(id) 
FROM cards 
WHERE borderColor = 'white' AND uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned')

question: Which cards are ranked 1st on EDHRec? List all of the cards name and its banned play format.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.edhrecRank = 1 AND T2.status = 'Banned' GROUP BY T1.name, T2.format

turns.sql:
SELECT c.name, l.format 
FROM cards c 
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1 AND l.status = 'Banned'

turns.hint: GROUP BY name, format을 추가해야 해 (중복 제거 목적).
turns.sql:
SELECT c.name, l.format 
FROM cards c 
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1 AND l.status = 'Banned' 
GROUP BY c.name, l.format

question: What languages are available in the set known as Archenemy on the magic card market and having the code ARC?

question: Please list the Italian names of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC

turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian' AND c.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode = s.code
)

turns.hint: DISTINCT는 빼야 해. 그리고 MAX 서브쿼리로 필터링하지 말고, convertedManaCost 기준으로 내림차순 정렬만 해줘 (LIMIT 없이 전체 반환).
turns.sql:
SELECT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian'
ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC

turns.hint: name은 fd.name이 아니라 c.name(cards 테이블의 이름)으로 SELECT해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian'
ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC

question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.frameVersion, T1.name , IIF(T2.status = 'Banned', T1.name, 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Allen Williams'

turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams' AND l.status = 'Banned'

turns.hint: WHERE에 status='Banned' 조건 걸지 말고 Allen Williams 카드 전체를 가져와. SELECT에 컬럼 하나 더 추가해서, status가 'Banned'면 카드 이름을, 아니면 'NO'를 반환하는 IIF문을 넣어야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name, IIF(l.status = 'Banned', c.name, 'NO') AS banned_card
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'

question: Is the set of cards with Adarkar Valkyrie only available outside the United States?
gold_sql: SELECT IIF(isForeignOnly = 1, 'YES', 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T1.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'

turns.sql:
SELECT sets.isForeignOnly 
FROM cards 
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code 
WHERE cards.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie' AND sets.isForeignOnly = 1

turns.hint: WHERE에 isForeignOnly=1 조건 걸지 말고, SELECT 안에서 IIF로 'YES'/'NO' 반환해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT IIF(sets.isForeignOnly = 1, 'YES', 'NO') AS isOnlyOutsideUS
FROM cards 
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code 
WHERE cards.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'
